notes: Every screen frame is named with a number (1-22). The numbers agree with the left-to-right order in each row, so they are kept as the step order.
Numbering runs across sections: 1-15 in 'Flow Chart - Flow', 16-18 in 'Color Options' (the section above it), then 19-22 back in 'Flow Chart - Flow'. Number 21 is not on the page.
All 1440 screens share one layout: Main_nav + content + 'Drag Handle', i.e. the chat + artifact split view with a flow-chart artifact.

The page-level parts to the left of the sections (nodes, arrows, connectors, popups, legends, staged edit, citation card) are the flow-chart component kit. They are listed under 'loose' with kit: true.
The 'Flow Chart - Artifact UI Improvements' card also holds a QA link: https://qa.matrix-qa.unifyapps.com/a/ua-enterprise-chat/homepage?initialChatId=e_6ab25561e89c4748343cf675
